name: Micropro Software Solutions Ltd.
summary: Micropro Software Solutions Ltd. is an Indian company that provides software development, technical services, and IT solutions, including the design, development, standardization, and customization of software across various industry verticals. The company also engages in the trading of IT hardware and software. Its key products include HospyCare, a hospital management information system; OpenSys Logix, a distribution management software; PharmaZip, tailored for pharmacy businesses; OpenSys MicroBooks, a cloud-based accounting solution; property tax management software; and a digital trading platform. Micropro Software Solutions offers a range of services such as infrastructure management, manpower services, network and security services, asset and configuration management, and IT consulting. The company primarily targets the healthcare sector, fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), pharmaceuticals (retailers, wholesalers, and stockists), departmental stores, jewelry businesses, central and state government entities, public sector undertakings, and corporate clients. Its operations and client base extend across India, the USA, the UAE, and Africa.
